note: The genesis state of the NearCraft economy. Deploy reads this. Nothing else does: the web page reads the deployed contracts over RPC, and the simulation builds its own sandbox economy rather than reading either. The Minecraft plugin in minecraft/ does not read this file either: it asks the play service, which reads the deployed contracts.
agent_gas_allowance_note: Measured in the sandbox: a function-call key's allowance is checked as a per-call ceiling against PREPAID gas and drawn down by gas actually burned. A 60 TGas call needs ~0.2 NEAR of headroom and burns ~0.007 NEAR, so 2 NEAR permits many calls. The earlier 0.25 would have left almost no margin. Never use max_gas() from an agent key: 300 TGas demands ~1 NEAR.

guard.note: The public blocklist agents report to. Without it deployed, counterparty.mjs falls into its `unavailable` branch and screening silently degrades — so deploy must create it.

players.note: Players are onboarded through backend/near/onboarding.mjs: an account derived from a verified identity, a one-time NEP-245 approval granted while a bootstrap full-access key exists, then that key deleted in the same transaction that installs the scoped one. Seeded demo players use a `seed:` provider so their ids derive exactly as a real login's would. See docs/GASLESS.md. A player key is immutable for life: onboarding deletes the bootstrap full-access key, so no method can ever be added to an existing player. Players onboarded before invest_with_credit existed keep the two methods they were issued.

relayer.note: Pays gas so a player never sees a gas prompt (NEP-366 meta transactions). Funded for GAS ONLY — it holds no spend budget and signs nothing of its own. gas_near is real NEAR and is NOT scaled by NEAR_ECONOMY_SCALE: 0.05 is below one 60 TGas call's prepaid cost, which is the three-pots trap in AGENTS.md. permitted_methods is the relayer's OWN allowlist — a relayer that submits anything is an open faucet for whoever asks. invest_with_credit is on the list because a player holding only a scoped key cannot pay for its own gas, so relaying is the ONLY way it can back a merchant — a method the player key permits but the relayer refuses is a method that does not exist for that player.
